ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity (white) peripheral regions; estimated distribution of 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity pixels on the fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep from the median notch extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparsely distributed high-intensity circular pixel clusters (salt-and-pepper effect) across the dark central regions of both lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast boundaries between the distal white pigmentation and the medial black pigmentation zones.
